verdict.rationale: Sentry documents its own mobile SDKs: the Android SDK automatically reports errors and exceptions, and Apple platforms are covered by the sentry-cocoa SDK. sentry-cli uploads debug information files for iOS and Android so Sentry can extract stack traces from crash reports on compiled platforms, which covers the core of native crash capture. missing for 10: explicit NDK/native-C++ crash capture evidence, documentation of attached device/OS/app-version context, independent or hands-on corroboration.
